a1.text: Whenever the pipe under my aunt's kitchen sink starts dripping, I'm the one who fixes it.
Every month I work out how much each of my housemates owes for the electricity and water.
I help my little brother with his maths homework before his exams.
I cut my friends' hair at home on Sundays.
I shoot photos at weddings and touch them up on my laptop afterwards.
At our coconut stall I keep track of how many we sell each day so we can reorder before we run out.
I turn my father's business letters from Malay into English.
I edit the videos for a friend's YouTube cooking channel.
Every Friday I cook nasi lemak for about sixty people at the surau.
I look after my grandmother, give her medicine on time and check her blood pressure every morning.
I write the captions and posts for my cousin's online bakery.
I drive my elderly neighbours to their hospital appointments.
I change the oil and replace the brake pads on my own car.
I coach the under-12 football team at our community field on Saturdays.
I sew baju kurung for customers and alter them when they don't fit.
I take the minutes at our residents' association meetings and send them out afterwards.
I lay bricks and mix the mortar when my uncle builds small house extensions.
At closing time I count the cash in the till and make sure it matches the receipts.
I grow chillies and vegetables in our backyard and spray them when insects attack.
At the phone shop I help customers pick a mobile plan that fits their budget.

a2.name: Siti
a2.other_work: I run the Instagram shop for my cousin's home bakery. I design the posters and price cards for the shop. I write the captions and plan which promotions to post each week. Every month I look at which cakes sold best and tell my cousin what to bake more of. I reply to customers' messages and sort out complaints about late orders.

a2.name: Arjun
a2.other_work: I help my uncle with house renovations on weekends. I measure the rooms and draw simple floor plans before we start. I work out how many bags of cement and tiles we need and what they will cost. I check that the walls are straight and the floor is level when the work is done. I order the materials from the hardware shop and arrange the delivery.

a2.name: Mei
a2.other_work: I volunteer at the blood donation drives organised by our community hall. I register the donors and record their details in the system. I explain the procedure to first-time donors and answer their questions. I help the nurses check donors' blood pressure and haemoglobin before they donate. I label the blood bags and keep the samples in the cooler box.

a2.name: Farid
a2.other_work: Neighbours call me when their lights or ceiling fans stop working. I find the faulty wiring and replace broken switches and sockets. I installed new lights and a water heater in my parents' house. I helped a contractor fit solar panels on a few roofs in our area. I test the circuits with a multimeter before I switch the power back on.

a2.name: Nurul
a2.other_work: I organise the yearly sports day for our neighbourhood association. I recruit volunteers and sort out who does which shift. I keep a spreadsheet of every volunteer's contact details and the hours they put in. When two volunteers fall out, I sit them down and help them sort it out. I run a short briefing for new volunteers about our safety rules.

a2.name: Daniel
a2.other_work: I repair motorcycles for friends in my garage. I listen to the engine and work out what is wrong before I open it up. I strip down carburettors, clean them and put them back together. I order the spare parts online and keep track of what each repair cost. I keep a notebook of each bike's service history.

a2.name: Aisyah
a2.field: Degree, teaching English as a second language
a2.other_work: Every evening I tutor primary school kids in English and maths at my house. I prepare worksheets and short reading exercises for each child. I mark their homework and keep a record of how each child is doing. I meet the parents every month to talk about their child's progress. I change my explanations when a child doesn't understand the first time.

a2.name: Rizal
a2.other_work: I run a fan page that posts statistics about Malaysian football. I collect match results from different websites into one big spreadsheet. I clean up the data when the sources don't agree. I work out averages and trends for each team and turn them into charts. Last year I ran a survey of our followers and wrote up what they told us.

a2.name: Hana
a2.other_work: My family has a small durian orchard and I manage it at weekends. I decide when to apply fertiliser and how much each tree needs. I check the trees for disease and spray them when pests show up. I keep records of how much fruit each section produces. I sell the fruit to wholesalers and agree the price each season.

a2.name: Kevin
a2.other_work: I am the treasurer of our residents' association. I collect the monthly fees and chase the households who haven't paid. I prepare the yearly budget and present it at the general meeting. I record every payment and receipt and prepare the year-end accounts. I compare quotes from contractors before we approve any repair work.
